# Phase Three — Thirty Additional Improvements

The Awtsmoos renews the plan when the plan thinks itself complete;
Awtsmoos.com asks one more time what could fail beneath the user's feet.

1. Verify whether Groupings uses `groupingsList` or a legacy container.
2. Verify `showLoading()` cannot erase synthetic content after rendering.
3. Verify `hideLoading()` does not change visibility.
4. Verify `switchView(..., render=false)` is followed by exactly one committed render.
5. Verify current view is synchronized before `afterContentLoaded`.
6. Verify root series detail object does not trigger non-root profile cards.
7. Verify Chitas grouping card normalization recognizes name/description.
8. Verify click navigation treats virtual grouping as series route deliberately.
9. Verify groupings renderer does not filter `virtual` records itself.
10. Verify Related section is hidden when switching away from Series.
11. Verify result status changes after switchView.
12. Verify search placeholder matches current active view.
13. Verify sticky bar observer starts from the intended anchor.
14. Verify sticky bar hides when at root/top.
15. Verify sticky bar does not duplicate Root when no parent exists.
16. Verify fixed global dock uses the highest needed z-index only.
17. Lower Advanced layering instead of escalating z-index wars.
18. Ensure inline Advanced width is 100% and no horizontal overflow.
19. Cap Advanced output height on mobile but allow internal scroll when opened.
20. Keep touch targets at least 44px.
21. Preserve safe-area bottom padding.
22. Reduce empty-state min-height below current 11rem on narrow phones.
23. Avoid hiding meaningful text solely to gain space.
24. Keep profile description at two lines maximum on phone.
25. Consider hiding profile stats if all are zero, but only if current DOM supports truthful dynamic state.
26. Keep Search + Filter in one compact row when width allows.
27. Preserve RTL/Hebrew layout.
28. Add tests for 0-post/2-series/1-grouping Ikar root data shape.
29. Run all existing Living Path tests after focused tests.
30. Verify public hashes after deploy, not just local syntax.
